entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.347 of 2024 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C.(C), Balasore, arising out of Industrial P.S. Case No.76 of 2024 for commission of offences punishable under Section 363 of IPC.
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that exaggerated allegations have been made in the F.I.R. and hence, he seeks pre-arrest bail.

4. Learned counsel for the State on the basis of the case diary submits that though the F.I.R. was initially registered under Section 363 of IPC, but during course of investigation, inter alia, the offences under Section 376(2)(n) of IPC and 6 of the POCSO Act have been added taking into account the statement of the victim.
Hence, he opposed the pre- arrest bail.
5. This Court perused the 164 of Cr.P.C. statement of the victim, taking note of which, this Court is not inclined to entertain the bail application.
6. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
